Organized Village of Kasaan

Organized Village of Kasaan is a Haida Tribal government whose public cultural-resource page and August 2025 public-review transport draft connect community history with priorities for access, language and learning. The draft was prepared by Native Strategies, LLC for OVK DOT. The Tribal government, City of Kasaan and local corporations remain distinct institutions.

These are selected starting points. The full annotated collection, source perspectives, inspection limits and remaining research questions follow below. A starting guide is not an exhaustive history or community endorsement.

01

Settlement change in the Tribe’s planning account

The August 2025 public-review draft recounts movement from Old Kasaan to the later settlement in a mining and cannery economy. It describes the Tribal government alongside a separate municipality and village corporation. These institutional distinctions help readers follow the different local organizations in Kasaan’s history.

Read the sources [1] Prepared for Organized Village of Kasaan DOT; Native Strategies, LLC named as preparer; proHNS LLC listed as a project-information contact

02

Connections and practical planning

The draft treats transportation as a community concern involving roads, island isolation and cooperation among several institutions. It sets out proposed priorities for access and maintenance. Its public-review status and stated priorities do not establish adoption, completed projects or present access to particular places.

Read the sources [1] Prepared for Organized Village of Kasaan DOT; Native Strategies, LLC named as preparer; proHNS LLC listed as a project-information contact

03

A place for Haida learning

The cultural-resource page describes the learning center and library as a place for Haida language, arts and community gatherings. At review it also displayed a closure and relocation notice. The page offers the Tribe’s public description of the library’s role, while present access and subsequent program changes remain to be checked.
